Before you hit apply

Two minutes that save you a month.

Find the company on LinkedIn. Real people? Real history?
Search the name + "scam" or "reviews". Reddit and Glassdoor talk.
Check it is a registered company on the MCA website.
Never pay anything. Not registration. Not "refundable".
Ask for the offer from a company email, not Gmail.
Verify first. Then apply.
